prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1162; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the collision you were involved in on a street in Pasadena, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state where you were coming from and where you were headed when the accident happened.

A: I was driving home from a grocery store. I was heading north on the main road toward my neighborhood.

Q: Can you describe the weather and road conditions at the time?

A: It was clear and dry. Traffic was light, and the road was straight there with no construction.

Q: Walk me through what happened right before impact.

A: The other car drifted into my lane while coming toward me. I braked and turned slightly to the right, but we still hit front to front. It wasn't a hard impact, but it was enough to jolt me forward.

Q: How fast do you believe you were traveling?

A: Maybe twenty-five miles per hour. I wasn't going fast.

Q: Did the airbags deploy in your vehicle?

A: No, they did not.

Q: Were you able to get out of the car on your own?

A: Yes, but my right knee hurt right away. It swelled up over the next few hours, and now I have trouble bending it and putting weight on it.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or received any treatment since the accident?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that same day. They took X-rays and told me to follow up with an orthopedic specialist. I have an appointment scheduled.

Q: Did you have any injuries or pain before this collision in that same knee?

A: No, I had no problems with that knee before this happened.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add about the accident?

A: Only that I'm worried about how long recovery will take, and I want to make sure the damage to my car and my medical bills are handled properly.

Q: Thank you. That concludes this statement.

A: Thank you.
